en-US:
Floe Agent 1.7.0 · Build 241

• PowerPoint: fixes blank slides during presentations. Please check starting a slideshow, changing slides, returning to editing, saving and reopening the file.
• Linux workspace: improves virtual-machine execution efficiency by reducing unnecessary synchronization. Performance varies by device and workload.
• Clearer wording across settings, document views and workspace messages.
• Downloaded MLX local models are labeled Beta / Experimental and are not recommended as the daily default. Apple’s system model is separate.

No Floe account is required for core Notes, documents and Canvas. Cloud AI is optional and uses your own provider credentials; third-party charges may apply. When sending feedback, include the device, OS, build number and reproduction steps, and remove private content and credentials from screenshots.
zh-Hans:
Floe Agent 1.7.0 · Build 241

• PowerPoint：修复放映页面空白。请检查开始放映、换页、返回编辑、保存和重新打开文件。
• Linux 工作区：减少不必要的同步开销，提高虚拟机运行效率。实际表现取决于设备和任务。
• 调整设置、文档和工作区提示，使描述更清楚。
• 下载的 MLX 本地模型标注为 Beta／实验性，暂不推荐作为日常首选。Apple 系统模型为独立功能。

手记、文档和画布的核心功能无需 Floe 账户。云端 AI 为可选功能，需使用你自己的服务商凭据，可能产生第三方费用。反馈请附设备、系统、构建号和复现步骤，截图前请遮去私人内容和凭据。
